description: Observabilidad de un sistema de transporte público a partir de GTFS Realtime: salud del feed, operación en calle y confiabilidad del servicio, sobre los feeds públicos de la MBTA leídos en vivo por DuckDB.

options.content:
### Observabilidad de un sistema de transporte con GTFS Realtime

Demostración sobre el feed público de la **MBTA** (Boston), en tres niveles: **salud del feed** — ¿llegan los datos y a tiempo? —, **operación en calle** — ¿dónde están los vehículos y cuáles circulan pegados? — y **confiabilidad del servicio** — ¿se cumple el intervalo programado?

Los filtros de arriba — **modo, ruta, estado y ocupación** — cruzan todo el tablero: el mapa se filtra al instante y las tablas, estadísticas e historia del metro se recalculan (estado y ocupación solo aplican a vehículos; la antigüedad del feed no se filtra).

Todo se consulta en vivo con DuckDB, sin base de datos intermedia: los feeds GTFS-RT en JSON pasan por una caché de 15 s (la MBTA pide no más de una petición cada 10 s) y la historia sale de los Parquet diarios de **LAMP**, el archivo de desempeño de la MBTA. Los umbrales de frescura siguen las buenas prácticas de GTFS Realtime (datos de menos de 90 s).

<small>Datos: Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority, bajo la MassDOT Developers License Agreement. Tablero independiente, sin afiliación con la MBTA.</small>

panels.description: Antigüedad del feed: segundos desde la marca de tiempo de su cabecera (incluye hasta 15 s de la caché). Verde hasta 60 s, ámbar hasta 90 s, rojo después: las buenas prácticas de GTFS Realtime piden datos de menos de 90 s. Posiciones de más de 90 s: vehículos cuyo último reporte quedó atrás de la cabecera más de ese umbral. Predicciones sin vehículo: viajes con horas estimadas pero sin unidad asignada — normal para salidas futuras, sospechoso si crece en hora punta.

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- MATERIALIZED so each feed is read once per query: the proxy refreshes its
-- copy every 15 s, and a second read landing after a refresh fails DuckDB's
-- ETag check.
WITH vp AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000)),
     tu AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/TripUpdates_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000)),
-- Vehicle counts follow all four filters, trip counts modo and ruta (a trip
-- has no status or occupancy). The feed's age is about the feed, so it reads
-- the unfiltered header.
v AS (SELECT header, e FROM vp WHERE CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ($ruta))
    AND CASE e.vehicle.current_status
    WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT_TO' THEN 'En tránsito'
    WHEN 'STOPPED_AT'    THEN 'Detenido en parada'
    WHEN 'INCOMING_AT'   THEN 'Llegando a parada'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END IN ($estado)
    AND CASE e.vehicle.occupancy_status
    WHEN 'EMPTY'                      THEN 'Vacío'
    WHEN 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE'       THEN 'Muchos asientos'
    WHEN 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE'        THEN 'Pocos asientos'
    WHEN 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY'         THEN 'Solo de pie'
    WHEN 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' THEN 'Muy lleno'
    WHEN 'FULL'                       THEN 'Lleno'
    WHEN 'NOT_ACCEPTING_PASSENGERS'   THEN 'No admite pasajeros'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END IN ($ocupacion)),
t AS (SELECT header, e FROM tu WHERE CASE
    WHEN e.trip_update.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.trip_update.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.trip_update.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.trip_update.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR e.trip_update.trip.route_id IN ($ruta)))
SELECT
  (SELECT (epoch(now()) - max(header.timestamp))::BIGINT FROM vp)                          AS "Antigüedad del feed",
  (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM v)                                                         AS "Vehículos reportando",
  (SELECT round(100.0 * avg((header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp > 90)::INT), 1) FROM v)  AS "Posiciones de más de 90 s",
  (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM t)                                                         AS "Viajes con predicción",
  (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.trip_update.trip.schedule_relationship = 'CANCELED')::BIGINT FROM t) AS "Viajes cancelados",
  (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.trip_update.trip.schedule_relationship = 'ADDED')::BIGINT FROM t)    AS "Viajes añadidos",
  (SELECT round(100.0 * avg((e.trip_update.vehicle.id IS NULL)::INT), 1) FROM t)           AS "Predicciones sin vehículo"

panels.description: Cada punto es un vehículo del último feed de posiciones. Verde: reportó hace 30 s o menos; ámbar: hasta 90 s; rojo: más, es decir, una unidad que el sistema cree en servicio pero que dejó de reportar. Haz clic en un vehículo para ver sus próximas paradas en la tabla de la derecha. Al elegir una fila de buses apelotonados, el mapa se acerca al par y lo marca con dos anillos que siguen a esos buses en cada refresco.

config.label: (heatmap) of Vehículos · frescura de la posición

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- `vehiculo`, not `vehicle_id`: the panel reads vehicle_id as a trajectory id
-- and would try to draw trips. No time column either, so this stays a snapshot.
-- Deliberately unfiltered: the map narrows itself through kepler filters bound
-- to the modo/ruta/estado/ocupacion variables, so a selection redraws at once
-- and widening it again needs no new query.
WITH vp AS (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000))
SELECT
  e.vehicle.vehicle.id                AS vehiculo,
  e.vehicle.vehicle.label             AS unidad,
  e.vehicle.trip.route_id             AS ruta,
  CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END                              AS modo,
  e.vehicle.position.latitude         AS latitude,
  e.vehicle.position.longitude        AS longitude,
  CASE e.vehicle.current_status
    WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT_TO' THEN 'En tránsito'
    WHEN 'STOPPED_AT'    THEN 'Detenido en parada'
    WHEN 'INCOMING_AT'   THEN 'Llegando a parada'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END                            AS estado,
  CASE e.vehicle.occupancy_status
    WHEN 'EMPTY'                      THEN 'Vacío'
    WHEN 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE'       THEN 'Muchos asientos'
    WHEN 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE'        THEN 'Pocos asientos'
    WHEN 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY'         THEN 'Solo de pie'
    WHEN 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' THEN 'Muy lleno'
    WHEN 'FULL'                       THEN 'Lleno'
    WHEN 'NOT_ACCEPTING_PASSENGERS'   THEN 'No admite pasajeros'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END                         AS ocupacion,
  (header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp)::BIGINT AS edad_s,
  CASE
    WHEN header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp <= 30 THEN '≤ 30 s'
    WHEN header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp <= 90 THEN '30–90 s'
    ELSE '> 90 s'
  END AS frescura
FROM vp

INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- The pair picked in the bunching table (variables parA and parB), read live
-- so the rings follow both buses on every refresh. Empty until a row is
-- clicked, which matches nothing.
WITH vp AS (SELECT unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000))
SELECT e.vehicle.vehicle.label       AS unidad,
       e.vehicle.trip.route_id       AS ruta,
       e.vehicle.position.latitude   AS latitude,
       e.vehicle.position.longitude  AS longitude
FROM vp
WHERE e.vehicle.vehicle.id IN ($parA, $parB)

panels.description: Pares de buses de la misma ruta y sentido a menos de 250 m. Un bus pegado a otro significa que detrás de ambos hay un hueco: la espera de la parada siguiente se alarga aunque la flota sea la programada. Se excluyen posiciones de más de 90 s y las dos primeras paradas del recorrido, donde los buses esperan en terminal. Separación: rojo por debajo de 50 m, naranja hasta 150 m, amarillo hasta 250 m. Haz clic en una fila para acercar el mapa al par.

links.title: Acercar el mapa a este par

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- Two buses of the same route and direction closer than 250 m. Stale
-- positions and the first two stops (terminal layovers) are left out. The
-- pair's midpoint and vehicle ids ride along hidden: the row's data link
-- writes them to lat/lng (the map centres) and parA/parB (the map rings them).
WITH vp AS (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000)),
paradas AS (
  -- The archive keeps every version of a stop; the newest name wins. Seven
  -- days back picks the year so the first week of January still finds a file.
  SELECT stop_id, arg_max(stop_name, gtfs_active_date) AS nombre
  FROM read_parquet('http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/gtfs_archive/' || strftime(current_date - 7, '%Y') || '/stops.parquet')
  GROUP BY 1
),
bus AS (
  SELECT e.vehicle.vehicle.id          AS id,
         e.vehicle.vehicle.label       AS unidad,
         e.vehicle.trip.route_id       AS ruta,
         e.vehicle.trip.direction_id   AS sentido,
         e.vehicle.position.latitude   AS lat,
         e.vehicle.position.longitude  AS lon,
         e.vehicle.stop_id             AS parada
  FROM vp
  WHERE header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp <= 90
    AND e.vehicle.current_stop_sequence > 2
    AND CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END = 'Bus'
    -- Modo and ruta only: status and occupancy do not make two buses bunched.
    AND CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ($ruta))
),
pares AS (
  SELECT a.ruta, a.unidad AS a, b.unidad AS b, a.id AS id_a, b.id AS id_b, a.parada,
         (a.lat + b.lat) / 2 AS lat_centro,
         (a.lon + b.lon) / 2 AS lng_centro,
         2 * 6371000 * asin(sqrt(pow(sin(radians(b.lat - a.lat) / 2), 2)
           + cos(radians(a.lat)) * cos(radians(b.lat)) * pow(sin(radians(b.lon - a.lon) / 2), 2))) AS metros
  FROM bus a JOIN bus b ON a.ruta = b.ruta AND a.sentido = b.sentido AND a.unidad < b.unidad
)
SELECT p.ruta                        AS "Ruta",
       p.a || ' + ' || p.b           AS "Buses",
       coalesce(s.nombre, p.parada)  AS "Cerca de",
       round(p.metros)::BIGINT       AS "Separación",
       -- Text, not numbers: a data link interpolates the cell's *formatted*
       -- value, and the table's automatic decimals print 42.344533 as 42.3.
       printf('%.6f', p.lat_centro)  AS lat_centro,
       printf('%.6f', p.lng_centro)  AS lng_centro,
       p.id_a,
       p.id_b
FROM pares p LEFT JOIN paradas s ON s.stop_id = p.parada
WHERE p.metros < 250
ORDER BY p.metros

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- $vehiculo is written by a click on the map; empty until then, which
-- matches nothing.
WITH tu AS (SELECT unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/TripUpdates_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000)),
paradas AS (
  -- The archive keeps every version of a stop; the newest name wins. Seven
  -- days back picks the year so the first week of January still finds a file.
  SELECT stop_id, arg_max(stop_name, gtfs_active_date) AS nombre
  FROM read_parquet('http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/gtfs_archive/' || strftime(current_date - 7, '%Y') || '/stops.parquet')
  GROUP BY 1
),
prox AS (
  SELECT e.trip_update.trip.route_id AS ruta,
         st.stop_sequence            AS orden,
         st.stop_id                  AS parada,
         coalesce(st.arrival.time, st.departure.time) AS t
  FROM (SELECT e, unnest(e.trip_update.stop_time_update) AS st FROM tu)
  WHERE e.trip_update.vehicle.id = $vehiculo
)
SELECT p.ruta                                         AS "Ruta",
       coalesce(n.nombre, p.parada)                   AS "Parada",
       to_timestamp(p.t)                              AS "Llegada estimada",
       round((p.t - epoch(now())) / 60.0)::BIGINT     AS "Faltan"
FROM prox p LEFT JOIN paradas n ON n.stop_id = p.parada
WHERE p.t >= epoch(now()) - 60
ORDER BY p.orden
LIMIT 15

INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

WITH vp AS (SELECT header, unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000)),
v AS (SELECT CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END AS modo, header.timestamp - e.vehicle.timestamp AS edad FROM vp WHERE CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ($ruta))
    AND CASE e.vehicle.current_status
    WHEN 'IN_TRANSIT_TO' THEN 'En tránsito'
    WHEN 'STOPPED_AT'    THEN 'Detenido en parada'
    WHEN 'INCOMING_AT'   THEN 'Llegando a parada'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END IN ($estado)
    AND CASE e.vehicle.occupancy_status
    WHEN 'EMPTY'                      THEN 'Vacío'
    WHEN 'MANY_SEATS_AVAILABLE'       THEN 'Muchos asientos'
    WHEN 'FEW_SEATS_AVAILABLE'        THEN 'Pocos asientos'
    WHEN 'STANDING_ROOM_ONLY'         THEN 'Solo de pie'
    WHEN 'CRUSHED_STANDING_ROOM_ONLY' THEN 'Muy lleno'
    WHEN 'FULL'                       THEN 'Lleno'
    WHEN 'NOT_ACCEPTING_PASSENGERS'   THEN 'No admite pasajeros'
    ELSE 'Sin dato'
  END IN ($ocupacion))
SELECT modo                                     AS "Modo",
       count(*)::BIGINT                         AS "Vehículos",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE edad > 90)::BIGINT AS "Posición de más de 90 s",
       max(edad)::BIGINT                        AS "Posición más vieja"
FROM v GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Feed Alerts: avisos vigentes ahora mismo, agrupados por el efecto que declara la agencia.

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

WITH al AS (SELECT unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/Alerts_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000))
SELECT
  CASE e.alert.effect
    WHEN 'NO_SERVICE'          THEN 'Sin servicio'
    WHEN 'REDUCED_SERVICE'     THEN 'Servicio reducido'
    WHEN 'SIGNIFICANT_DELAYS'  THEN 'Retrasos importantes'
    WHEN 'DETOUR'              THEN 'Desvío'
    WHEN 'ADDITIONAL_SERVICE'  THEN 'Servicio adicional'
    WHEN 'MODIFIED_SERVICE'    THEN 'Servicio modificado'
    WHEN 'STOP_MOVED'          THEN 'Parada reubicada'
    WHEN 'ACCESSIBILITY_ISSUE' THEN 'Accesibilidad'
    WHEN 'OTHER_EFFECT'        THEN 'Otro'
    ELSE 'Sin especificar'
  END AS "Efecto",
  count(*)::BIGINT AS "Alertas"
FROM al
-- Active now: some period has started and has not ended (no end = open).
WHERE len(list_filter(e.alert.active_period,
          p -> p.start <= epoch(now()) AND coalesce(p."end", 9999999999) >= epoch(now()))) > 0
  -- And it names at least one route inside the modo and ruta selection.
  AND len(list_filter(e.alert.informed_entity,
          x -> x.route_id IS NOT NULL
               AND CASE
    WHEN x.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR x.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN x.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN x.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN ($modo)
               AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR x.route_id IN ($ruta)))) > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Del archivo LAMP de la MBTA: cada paso de un tren por una estación con su intervalo real y el programado. Espera excesiva = espera esperada real − programada, con espera esperada = Σh² / 2Σh (la métrica de MBTA, TfL y MTA). Huecos: intervalos de más de 1,5 veces lo programado. Apelotonados: menos de un cuarto. Minutos.

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- One LAMP file per service day in the dashboard range. Capped at 31 days and
-- at yesterday in Boston: today's file may not exist yet, and a missing file
-- fails the whole read. A range inside today still reads yesterday.
WITH d AS (
  -- Branch headways where the station is on a branch (Green-B/C/D/E), trunk
  -- headways otherwise; comparing a branch stop against the trunk schedule
  -- invents gaps. Intervals of an hour or more are the overnight break.
  SELECT trunk_route_id AS linea,
         route_id,
         parent_station,
         direction_destination,
         to_timestamp(stop_timestamp) AS t,
         coalesce(headway_branch_seconds, headway_trunk_seconds)     AS h,
         coalesce(scheduled_headway_branch, scheduled_headway_trunk) AS hs
  FROM read_parquet([
  'http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/subway-on-time-performance-v1/' || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') || '-subway-on-time-performance-v1.parquet'
  FOR d IN generate_series(
    least(greatest(CAST($__timeFrom() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE - 30), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    least(CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    INTERVAL 1 DAY)
])
),
-- Some rows carry headways but no stop timestamp; a null in the time column
-- makes Grafana's time series report all of its data as out of range.
-- The dashboard's modo and ruta filters reach the history too. LAMP's route_id
-- uses the live feed's ids (Green-B…E, Red, Orange, Blue, Mattapan), so the same
-- selection applies unchanged; a selection without Metro leaves it empty.
ok AS (
  SELECT * FROM d
  WHERE t IS NOT NULL AND h > 0 AND hs > 0 AND h < 3600 AND hs < 3600
    AND 'Metro' IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR route_id IN ($ruta))
)
SELECT linea                                              AS "Línea",
       count(*)::BIGINT                                   AS "Pasos",
       round(median(h) / 60.0, 1)                         AS "Real",
       round(median(hs) / 60.0, 1)                        AS "Programado",
       -- Excess wait time: a rider's expected wait, Σh²/2Σh, real minus scheduled.
       round((sum(h ^ 2) / (2 * sum(h)) - sum(hs ^ 2) / (2 * sum(hs))) / 60.0, 2)                                    AS "Espera excesiva",
       round(100.0 * avg((h < 0.25 * hs)::INT), 1)        AS "Apelotonados",
       round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT), 1)         AS "Huecos"
FROM ok GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Intervalos por línea

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- One LAMP file per service day in the dashboard range. Capped at 31 days and
-- at yesterday in Boston: today's file may not exist yet, and a missing file
-- fails the whole read. A range inside today still reads yesterday.
WITH d AS (
  -- Branch headways where the station is on a branch (Green-B/C/D/E), trunk
  -- headways otherwise; comparing a branch stop against the trunk schedule
  -- invents gaps. Intervals of an hour or more are the overnight break.
  SELECT trunk_route_id AS linea,
         route_id,
         parent_station,
         direction_destination,
         to_timestamp(stop_timestamp) AS t,
         coalesce(headway_branch_seconds, headway_trunk_seconds)     AS h,
         coalesce(scheduled_headway_branch, scheduled_headway_trunk) AS hs
  FROM read_parquet([
  'http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/subway-on-time-performance-v1/' || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') || '-subway-on-time-performance-v1.parquet'
  FOR d IN generate_series(
    least(greatest(CAST($__timeFrom() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE - 30), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    least(CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    INTERVAL 1 DAY)
])
),
-- Some rows carry headways but no stop timestamp; a null in the time column
-- makes Grafana's time series report all of its data as out of range.
-- The dashboard's modo and ruta filters reach the history too. LAMP's route_id
-- uses the live feed's ids (Green-B…E, Red, Orange, Blue, Mattapan), so the same
-- selection applies unchanged; a selection without Metro leaves it empty.
ok AS (
  SELECT * FROM d
  WHERE t IS NOT NULL AND h > 0 AND hs > 0 AND h < 3600 AND hs < 3600
    AND 'Metro' IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR route_id IN ($ruta))
)
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 HOUR, t) AS time,
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Red') >= 20
         THEN round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Red'), 1) END AS "Red",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Orange') >= 20
         THEN round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Orange'), 1) END AS "Orange",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Blue') >= 20
         THEN round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Blue'), 1) END AS "Blue",
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Green') >= 20
         THEN round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT) FILTER (WHERE linea = 'Green'), 1) END AS "Green"
FROM ok GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Por estación y sentido, con al menos 100 pasos medidos en el rango. Es la tabla que un jefe de operaciones abre primero: dice dónde se rompe la regularidad, no solo cuánto.

targets.rawSql:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- One LAMP file per service day in the dashboard range. Capped at 31 days and
-- at yesterday in Boston: today's file may not exist yet, and a missing file
-- fails the whole read. A range inside today still reads yesterday.
WITH d AS (
  -- Branch headways where the station is on a branch (Green-B/C/D/E), trunk
  -- headways otherwise; comparing a branch stop against the trunk schedule
  -- invents gaps. Intervals of an hour or more are the overnight break.
  SELECT trunk_route_id AS linea,
         route_id,
         parent_station,
         direction_destination,
         to_timestamp(stop_timestamp) AS t,
         coalesce(headway_branch_seconds, headway_trunk_seconds)     AS h,
         coalesce(scheduled_headway_branch, scheduled_headway_trunk) AS hs
  FROM read_parquet([
  'http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/subway-on-time-performance-v1/' || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') || '-subway-on-time-performance-v1.parquet'
  FOR d IN generate_series(
    least(greatest(CAST($__timeFrom() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE - 30), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    least(CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    INTERVAL 1 DAY)
])
),
-- Some rows carry headways but no stop timestamp; a null in the time column
-- makes Grafana's time series report all of its data as out of range.
-- The dashboard's modo and ruta filters reach the history too. LAMP's route_id
-- uses the live feed's ids (Green-B…E, Red, Orange, Blue, Mattapan), so the same
-- selection applies unchanged; a selection without Metro leaves it empty.
ok AS (
  SELECT * FROM d
  WHERE t IS NOT NULL AND h > 0 AND hs > 0 AND h < 3600 AND hs < 3600
    AND 'Metro' IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR route_id IN ($ruta))
),
paradas AS (
  -- The archive keeps every version of a stop; the newest name wins. Seven
  -- days back picks the year so the first week of January still finds a file.
  SELECT stop_id, arg_max(stop_name, gtfs_active_date) AS nombre
  FROM read_parquet('http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/gtfs_archive/' || strftime(current_date - 7, '%Y') || '/stops.parquet')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.linea                                  AS "Línea",
       coalesce(p.nombre, o.parent_station)     AS "Estación",
       o.direction_destination                  AS "Hacia",
       count(*)::BIGINT                         AS "Pasos",
       round((sum(h ^ 2) / (2 * sum(h)) - sum(hs ^ 2) / (2 * sum(hs))) / 60.0, 1)                          AS "Espera excesiva",
       round(100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT), 1) AS "Huecos"
FROM ok o LEFT JOIN paradas p ON p.stop_id = o.parent_station
GROUP BY ALL
HAVING count(*) >= 100
ORDER BY "Espera excesiva" DESC
LIMIT 10

INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- fails the whole read. A range inside today still reads yesterday.
WITH d AS (

  -- invents gaps. Intervals of an hour or more are the overnight break.

         route_id,
         parent_station,
         direction_destination,
         to_timestamp(stop_timestamp) AS t,
         coalesce(headway_branch_seconds, headway_trunk_seconds)     AS h,
         coalesce(scheduled_headway_branch, scheduled_headway_trunk) AS hs
  FROM read_parquet([
  'http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/subway-on-time-performance-v1/' || strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') || '-subway-on-time-performance-v1.parquet'
  FOR d IN generate_series(
    least(greatest(CAST($__timeFrom() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE - 30), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    least(CAST($__timeTo() AS TIMESTAMPTZ)::DATE, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::DATE - 1),
    INTERVAL 1 DAY)
])
),
-- Some rows carry headways but no stop timestamp; a null in the time column
-- makes Grafana's time series report all of its data as out of range.
-- The dashboard's modo and ruta filters reach the history too. LAMP's route_id
-- uses the live feed's ids (Green-B…E, Red, Orange, Blue, Mattapan), so the same
-- selection applies unchanged; a selection without Metro leaves it empty.
ok AS (
  SELECT * FROM d
  WHERE t IS NOT NULL AND h > 0 AND hs > 0 AND h < 3600 AND hs < 3600
    AND 'Metro' IN ($modo)
    AND ('__todas__' IN ($ruta) OR route_id IN ($ruta))
),
paradas AS (
  SELECT stop_id,
         arg_max(stop_name, gtfs_active_date) AS nombre,
         arg_max(stop_lat, gtfs_active_date)  AS lat,
         arg_max(stop_lon, gtfs_active_date)  AS lon
  FROM read_parquet('http://sources-data/mbta/lamp/gtfs_archive/' || strftime(current_date - 7, '%Y') || '/stops.parquet')
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- Excess wait per station, line and direction first, as in the table. Pooling
-- the headways of two lines into one Σh² would describe a wait no rider has.
tramo AS (
  SELECT parent_station, linea, direction_destination AS hacia,
         count(*) AS pasos,
         (sum(h ^ 2) / (2 * sum(h)) - sum(hs ^ 2) / (2 * sum(hs))) / 60.0 AS ewt,
         100.0 * avg((h > 1.5 * hs)::INT) AS huecos
  FROM ok GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*) >= 100
),
-- One point per station, carrying its worst direction.
estacion AS (
  SELECT parent_station,
         string_agg(DISTINCT linea, ' / ' ORDER BY linea) AS lineas,
         sum(pasos)::BIGINT                              AS pasos,
         max(ewt)                                        AS ewt,
         arg_max(linea || ' hacia ' || hacia, ewt)       AS peor_sentido,
         arg_max(huecos, ewt)                            AS huecos
  FROM tramo GROUP BY 1
)
-- No column called count or direction: the panel reads both as field roles.
SELECT p.nombre                      AS estacion,
       e.lineas,
       e.peor_sentido,
       p.lat                         AS latitude,
       p.lon                         AS longitude,
       e.pasos,
       round(e.ewt, 2)               AS espera_excesiva,
       round(e.huecos, 1)            AS huecos,
       -- Size channel: better-than-scheduled stations come out negative.
       round(greatest(e.ewt, 0), 2)  AS peso,
       CASE WHEN e.ewt < 1 THEN '< 1 min' WHEN e.ewt < 2 THEN '1–2 min' ELSE '> 2 min' END AS banda
FROM estacion e JOIN paradas p ON p.stop_id = e.parent_station

panels.title: Dónde se rompe la regularidad

list.definition:
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SET force_download = true;

-- Variable query: Grafana does not quote variables here as it does in panel
-- queries, so modo is spelled out with the sqlstring format.
SELECT ruta FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.vehicle.trip.route_id AS ruta, CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END AS modo
  FROM (SELECT unnest(entity) AS e FROM read_json('http://sources-data/mbta/realtime/VehiclePositions_enhanced.json', maximum_object_size = 50000000))
  WHERE e.vehicle.trip.route_id IS NOT NULL
    AND CASE
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id IN ('Red', 'Orange', 'Blue', 'Mattapan') OR e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Green-%' THEN 'Metro'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'CR-%'   THEN 'Tren de cercanías'
    WHEN e.vehicle.trip.route_id LIKE 'Boat-%' THEN 'Ferry'
    ELSE 'Bus'
  END IN (${modo:sqlstring})
)
ORDER BY CASE modo WHEN 'Metro' THEN 0 WHEN 'Tren de cercanías' THEN 1 WHEN 'Ferry' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         try_cast(ruta AS INTEGER) NULLS LAST, ruta
